params.caption: 🕹️ Sony scraps live-service shooter Fairgame$ According to Bloomberg, PlayStation has cancelled Fairgame$, the PS5 live-service shooter from Haven Studios in Montreal. The concept was reworked several times over the past three years, but no job cuts are tied to the cancellation, and Haven reportedly plans to move on to a new game. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 23:43 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot #PlayStation #Fairgames #GamingNews
